FN-I3FX166-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 447
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
House Bill 447 as introduced would reduce the obligations of any local boards of education by
an undetermined amount dependent on the cost of transporting community or technical college
students on public school buses, under certain conditions, which requirement is repealed by this
bill.
Page 1

FN-I3FX166-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 447
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Representative Danny Garrett
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2025
House Bill 447 as reported by the Committee on Ways and Means Education would reduce the
obligations of any local boards of education by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost
of transporting community or technical college students on public school buses, under certain
conditions, which requirement is repealed by this bill.
This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of the various local boards of
education to adopt policies regarding transportation of enrolled students to certain off-site
educational venues.
Page 1
